blocks.zh: 负阶 Sobolev 空间与对偶性
blocks.label: sec:negative-sobolev-duality

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: According to the Riesz representation theorem, Hilbert spaces are isometric to their dual spaces. Hence every linear functional on $H^k(\Omega)$ has a representation of the form $l(v)=(u,v)_k$. However, the inner product $(u,v)_k$ does not agree with the action of $u$ as a distribution. In fact, since test functions are generally not dense in $H^k(\Omega)$, linear functionals are not necessarily distributions; there are nonzero linear functionals which vanish on all test functions. We make the following definition.
blocks.zh: 根据 Riesz 表示定理, Hilbert 空间与其对偶空间等距. 因而 $H^k(\Omega)$ 上每个线性泛函都具有 $l(v)=(u,v)_k$ 形式的表示. 然而, 内积 $(u,v)_k$ 与 $u$ 作为分布的作用并不一致. 事实上, 由于试验函数一般在 $H^k(\Omega)$ 中不稠密, 线性泛函未必是分布; 存在对所有试验函数都为零的非零线性泛函. 作如下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: By $H^{-k}(\Omega)$, we denote the set of all linear functionals on $H_0^k(\Omega)$. Moreover, if $M$ is $\mathbb{R}^m$ or a compact manifold of class $C^k$, $k>s$, then $H^{-s}(M)$ denotes the dual space of $H^s(M)$.
blocks.zh: 用 $H^{-k}(\Omega)$ 表示 $H_0^k(\Omega)$ 上所有线性泛函的集合. 此外, 若 $M$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 或 $C^k$ 类紧流形, $k>s$, 则 $H^{-s}(M)$ 表示 $H^s(M)$ 的对偶空间.
blocks.label: def:negative-order-sobolev-dual-spaces

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Since $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ is dense in $H_0^k(\Omega)$, $H^{-k}(\Omega)$ is a space of distributions. As we will see in the following examples, negative Sobolev spaces contain singular distributions.
blocks.zh: 由于 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 在 $H_0^k(\Omega)$ 中稠密, $H^{-k}(\Omega)$ 是一个分布空间. 正如下面的例子所示, 负阶 Sobolev 空间包含奇异分布.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Suppose $k>m/2$ and $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^m$ has the $k$-extension property and contains the origin. Then the Dirac delta is in $H^{-k}(\Omega)$. To see this we note that the Sobolev imbedding theorem ensures that $H^k(\Omega)$ (and hence $H_0^k(\Omega)$) is continuously imbedded in $C_b(\overline\Omega)$. This ensures that the delta distribution in well defined. It is also a bounded linear functional on $H_0^k(\Omega)$ since for every $u\in H_0^k(\Omega)$\[|(\delta,u)|:=|u(\bm{0})|\leq\|u\|_{\infty}\leq C\|u\|_{H^k(\Omega)}.\]
blocks.zh: 假设 $k>m/2$, $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^m$ 具有 $k$ 阶延拓性质且包含原点. 那么 Dirac delta 属于 $H^{-k}(\Omega)$. 为说明这一点, 注意 Sobolev 嵌入定理保证 $H^k(\Omega)$ (因而还有 $H_0^k(\Omega)$) 连续嵌入 $C_b(\overline\Omega)$. 这保证 delta 分布有良好定义. 它也是 $H_0^k(\Omega)$ 上的有界线性泛函, 因为对每个 $u\in H_0^k(\Omega)$ 有\[|(\delta,u)|:=|u(\bm{0})|\leq\|u\|_{\infty}\leq C\|u\|_{H^k(\Omega)}.\]
blocks.label: ex:dirac-negative-sobolev-membership

blocks.en: For any given $f\in H^{-k}(\Omega)$, there is therefore a unique $u\in H_0^k(\Omega)$ satisfying the partial differential equation \eqref{eq:negative-sobolev-elliptic-derivative-representation}. Recall that the condition $u\in H_0^k(\Omega)$ can be interpreted as a boundary condition: $u=\partial u/\partial n=\cdots=\partial^{k-1}u/\partial n^{k-1}=0$ on $\partial\Omega$ (Theorem~\ref{thm:zero-boundary-sobolev-characterization}). Considerations similar to the one just given form the starting point of the modern existence theory for elliptic boundary-value problems; we shall return to this in Chapter~\ref{chap:linear-elliptic-equations}.
blocks.zh: 因此, 对任意给定的 $f\in H^{-k}(\Omega)$, 存在唯一的 $u\in H_0^k(\Omega)$ 满足偏微分方程 \eqref{eq:negative-sobolev-elliptic-derivative-representation}. 回顾条件 $u\in H_0^k(\Omega)$ 可解释为边界条件: 在 $\partial\Omega$ 上有 $u=\partial u/\partial n=\cdots=\partial^{k-1}u/\partial n^{k-1}=0$ (Theorem~\ref{thm:zero-boundary-sobolev-characterization}). 与上述类似的考察构成椭圆边值问题现代存在性理论的出发点; 将在 Chapter~\ref{chap:linear-elliptic-equations} 回到这一问题.

blocks.en: We conclude with a simple statement about differentiation of distributions in negative Sobolev spaces.
blocks.zh: 最后给出一个关于负阶 Sobolev 空间中分布求导的简单断言.

blocks.en: Let $u\in H^k(\Omega)$, $k\in\mathbb{Z}$. Then $\partial u/\partial x_i\in H^{k-1}(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $u\in H^k(\Omega)$, $k\in\mathbb{Z}$. 那么 $\partial u/\partial x_i\in H^{k-1}(\Omega)$.

blocks.en: Let $f\in H^{-k}(\Omega)$, $k\in\mathbb{N}$. Then there exist functions $g_\alpha\in L^2(\Omega)$ such that $f=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq k}D^\alpha g_\alpha$.
blocks.zh: 设 $f\in H^{-k}(\Omega)$, $k\in\mathbb{N}$. 那么存在函数 $g_\alpha\in L^2(\Omega)$, 使 $f=\sum_{|\alpha|\leq k}D^\alpha g_\alpha$.
blocks.label: lem:negative-sobolev-l-two-derivative-representation

blocks.en: For the proof, we simply set $g_\alpha=(-1)^{|\alpha|}D^\alpha u$ in \eqref{eq:negative-sobolev-elliptic-derivative-representation}.
blocks.zh: 证明时, 只需在 \eqref{eq:negative-sobolev-elliptic-derivative-representation} 中令 $g_\alpha=(-1)^{|\alpha|}D^\alpha u$.
